description: Create a presentation (a talk/deck) tied to a campaign or event. Slides live once; each variant (language, partner logo) picks order and speaker notes. Required: title. Optional: campaign_id, event_name, event_date (ISO), location, target_duration_sec, template (corporate-design key), status (draft|ready|archived). Returns { presentation_id }.

event_name.description: Name of the event where the talk is given

location.description: Venue or location of the talk

target_duration_sec.description: Planned length of the talk in seconds

name: create_presentation
